label: Copy existing doctor names and emails

precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM "public"."doctor"
              WHERE "name" IS NULL OR "email" IS NULL
            ) AS ok

execute.description: Copy profile data from linked users
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."doctor" AS d
              SET "name" = u."name", "email" = u."email"
              FROM "public"."user" AS u
              WHERE d."userId" = u."id"
                AND (d."name" IS NULL OR d."email" IS NULL)
